shared_elements: animal/creature with head shown in profile
simplified, blocky rendering of animal bodies
raised/rounded projecting forms (arched shapes in A, limbs and muzzle in B)
justification: Both show a simplified, heavy-featured animal with a profile head carved in the same pale, pitted limestone, and both use fine incised hatching or net-like lines as surface detail over an otherwise smooth mass. The decisive difference is mode: A is a flat slab organised into stacked horizontal registers of shallow relief figures, while B is a single free-standing sculpture in the round with no registers or compositional sequence.
